newsitem.title: USA: Stryker Corp sets stock repurchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Stryker Corp sets stock repurchase plan.

text.p: Stryker Corp said Wednesday its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to one million shares of its common stock.
The maker of orthopedic implants and specialty surgical and medical products said it will make share purchases in the open market from time to time depending on prevailing market conditions.
As of March 31, there were 96,075,304 shares outstanding. The new authorization replaces the April 24, 1996, authorization to repurchase one million shares, all of which have been repurchased.
Stryker said it will use the shares for employee stock option plans and other corporate purposes.
